dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I'm looking to purchase a new pair of shoes. I have a budget between $500 and $5000, and I'm particularly interested in waterproof shoes that have at least a 3 out of 5 star average customer rating. Could you please tell me about any shoes in your inventory that might fit those criteria?

Unfortunately, I did not find any waterproof shoes in your desired price range of $500 to $5000 that have at least a 3 out of 5 star average customer rating. The searches I performed did not return any matching results.

However, I would be happy to try a different search if you have any other preferences or criteria you'd like me to look for. For example, would you be open to shoes that aren't necessarily waterproof, but have good reviews for comfort and durability? I can try searching for those types of shoes next.

dialogue.user: Hmm, okay. If there are no waterproof shoes in my price range with good reviews, let's try a different approach. What are some of your most highly rated and durable shoe options, even if they aren't waterproof? I'm open to considering those as well, as long as they have at least a 3 out of 5 star average rating.

products.description: You don't have to be inside to enjoy the comfort of a house shoe. Made with water-resistant nylon upper, the Howser 3 Causal Slide for women is built off KEEN’s traditional wider footwear form. products.title: Dearfoams Women's Fireside Shearling Water Resistant Indoor/Outdoor Foldover Boot Slipper
products.description: Luxury for everyone. That’s the idea behind the Fireside Collection: a line of slippers that an everyday price on superior quality competitive with other slipper brands. Perfect as a thoughtful gift for your loved ones, Fireside shearling slippers are sure to be their new favorite way to relax! Made with genuine Australian sheepskin lining, these affordable shearling slippers are a must for relaxing in style. But why shearling? Shearling boasts natural temperature-regulating and moisture-wicking properties. They’re a great blend of insulated and breathable, and a few of our styles even feature water-resistant designs to help protect you from the elements. Shearling is also known for its durability; these long-lasting slippers are sure to be favorites for years to come! Temperature-regulating and moisture-wicking slippers are perfect no matter the weather, and these indoor/outdoor slippers are built to handle the busiest of days. Our men’s shearling slippers, women’s shearling slippers, and kids’ shearling slippers are designed with unbeatable quality in mind.
